_stress_scenario: Documents a diagnostic laparoscopy converted to an open procedure in the same session. The diagnostic scope is NCCI-bundled into the definitive open procedure and is not separately billable. Tests whether the deterministic edit check catches the bundle instead of drafting both as separate charge lines.

documents.text: Diagnostic laparoscopy performed first to assess extent of disease. Dense adhesions and gangrenous appendix precluded safe laparoscopic completion. Converted to open approach. Open appendectomy completed without complication.
